title: Differential Diagnosis of Frontotemporal Dementia and Alzheimer's Disease using Generative Adversarial Network
abstract: arXiv:2109.05627v2 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Frontotemporal dementia and Alzheimer's disease are two common forms of dementia and are easily misdiagnosed as each other due to their similar pattern of clinical symptoms. Differentiating between the two dementia types is crucial for determining disease-specific intervention and treatment. Recent development of Deep-learning-based approaches in the field of medical image computing are delivering some of the best performance for many binary classification tasks, although its application in differential diagnosis, such as neuroimage-based differentiation for multiple types of dementia, has not been explored. In this study, a novel framework was proposed by using the Generative Adversarial Network technique to distinguish FTD, AD and normal control subjects, using volumetric features extracted at coarse-to-fine structural scales from Magnetic Resonance Imaging scans. translated_title: 使用生成对抗网络进行额颞叶痴呆与阿尔茨海默病的鉴别诊断
translated_abstract: 额颞叶痴呆（FTD）和阿尔茨海默病（AD）是两种常见的痴呆类型，由于其临床症状模式相似，很容易被相互误诊。区分这两种痴呆类型对于确定疾病特异性的干预和治疗至关重要。近年来，基于深度学习的方法在医学图像计算领域的发展在许多二分类任务中表现出色，但其在鉴别诊断中的应用，例如基于神经影像的多种痴呆类型鉴别，尚未被探索。在本研究中，提出了一种新颖的框架，使用生成对抗网络技术，基于从磁共振成像扫描中以粗到细结构尺度提取的体积特征，来区分额颞叶痴呆、阿尔茨海默病和正常对照受试者。在1,954张图像上进行的10折交叉验证实验取得了很高的（分类性能）。
tldr: 本研究提出了一种基于生成对抗网络的新框架，利用磁共振图像中粗到细结构尺度的体积特征，实现了对额颞叶痴呆、阿尔茨海默病和正常对照的高精度鉴别诊断。
en_tdlr: This study proposes a novel framework using Generative Adversarial Networks to differentiate Frontotemporal Dementia, Alzheimer's Disease, and normal controls with high accuracy, based on volumetric features extracted from MRI scans at coarse-to-fine structural scales.
